note: The plate after the reveal, on research's verdict (AR12, "Research's verdict on the reveal's card, in Eclipse"). The plate is the kit's panel (build/handoff/UI/kit/kit.json) in `colours`; the four images here are its marks, and CoinMint is the HUD's own (hud_colour.json). A white image takes its tint; a dark part baked into one stays dark. Every measure is in points from the plate's top left; a line's `middle` is the height its text and its mark are centred on. Words are the build's own; their widths here were measured in Blender's face, so `room` is a seed. DESIGN, untried in Studio.

plate.anchor: under the ceremony's name, left-aligned with it, never to the screen, so it holds on the smallest phone; the held frame stays undimmed behind it. On the accepted sheet it stood at 113, 256 of an 812 by 375 screen. The gap under the name's line is the builder's, from the build's own name.
